concept.title: Health checks and assessments
concept.shortdesc: Routine health checks and formal assessments of a person's needs with any resulting care plans.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Quick routine health checks such as blood pressure testing, NHS health checks and baby development checks.
: Formal assessments of a person's needs, such as autism, dyslexia or skills assessments, and the plans that follow.
